rows.vgi.doc_llm:
## audio.example_clips

A **browsable table** (no arguments) listing the worker's built-in example audio clips, one row each: `name`, a one-line `description`, the decoded `duration`/`sample_rate`/`channels`, the detected `beat_count`, and the raw `audio` `BLOB`.

**When to use.** Start here to see real sample data and to grab a ready-made audio blob: select the `audio` column for a clip and pass it directly to any feature function (`duration`, `tempo`, `mfcc`, `beats`, `audio_info`, ...) without needing a file on disk. The `tone` clip is a steady sine (good for the metadata/spectral scalars); the `click` clip has a clear 120 BPM pulse (good for `tempo` and `beats`).
rows.vgi.doc_md:
# example_clips

A browsable discovery table of the worker's built-in example audio clips.

| column | type | description |
|---|---|---|
| `name` | VARCHAR | Short clip identifier (`tone`, `click`). |
| `description` | VARCHAR | What the clip is. |
| `duration` | DOUBLE | Duration in seconds. |
| `sample_rate` | INTEGER | Native sample rate in Hz. |
| `channels` | INTEGER | Number of audio channels. |
| `beat_count` | INTEGER | Number of beats librosa detects in the clip. |
| `audio` | BLOB | Raw audio file bytes (WAV or FLAC) to feed any feature function. |

Select the `audio` column of a row and pass it straight into a scalar or table function to try the worker with no file on disk.
rows.vgi.example_queries: [{"description": "List the built-in example clips with their core metadata.", "sql": "SELECT name, description, duration, sample_rate, channels FROM audio.main.example_clips ORDER BY name"}, {"description": "Estimate the tempo of the built-in click track by feeding its bytes to tempo().", "sql": "SELECT audio.main.tempo(audio) AS bpm FROM audio.main.example_clips WHERE name = 'click'"}, {"description": "Skip quiet clips (mean RMS energy at or below 0.1), then report brightness and estimated key for the built-in clips that remain.", "sql": "SELECT name, round(audio.main.rms_energy(audio), 3) AS rms, round(audio.main.spectral_centroid(audio), 1) AS centroid_hz, audio.main.estimated_key(audio) AS musical_key FROM audio.main.example_clips WHERE audio.main.rms_energy(audio) > 0.1 ORDER BY name"}]
rows.vgi.title: Built-in Example Audio Clips

rows: CREATE TABLE example_clips("name" VARCHAR, description VARCHAR NOT NULL, duration DOUBLE NOT NULL, sample_rate INTEGER NOT NULL, channels INTEGER NOT NULL, beat_count INTEGER NOT NULL, audio BLOB NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY("name"));
